work.name: Review a support response
work.expectedResult: A draft response that answers the customer question and identifies the approved policy used.

boundaries.approvedInputs: Customer message, current support policy, and the status fields required to answer the question.
boundaries.excludedInputs: Private staff notes, expired policies, and records belonging to other customers.
boundaries.allowedActions: Draft a response, identify the relevant policy section, and flag missing information.
boundaries.humanReviewRequiredBefore: Sending a response, changing an account, issuing credit, or making an exception to policy.

proof.acceptanceChecks: Answers the stated question; cites an approved policy; makes no unsupported promise; includes no unrelated private information.
proof.failureAndRefusalCases: No current policy is available; instructions conflict; the requested action exceeds the stated authority.
proof.evidenceToKeep: Work-order version, input record IDs, policy version, model and instruction version, checks passed or failed, and reviewer decision.
